python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import label

# obs 27: camera at (0.0, 2.5), heading -x
# Left chair is Chair A (south), Right chair is Chair B (north)
arr27 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0027.png').convert('RGB'))
chair_m = (arr27[:, :, 0] > 70) & (arr27[:, :, 0] < 160) & (arr27[:, :, 1] > 30) & (arr27[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr27[:, :, 2] < 50) & (arr27[:, :, 0] > arr27[:, :, 1] + 20)

labeled, n = label(chair_m)
for i in range(1, n+1):
    ys, xs = np.where(labeled == i)
    if len(ys) > 50:
        bot = ys.max()
        d = 1.55 * 256 / (bot - 255.5)
        # In obs 27 (heading -x):
        # forward is -x, right is +y
        # col_c is along camera right
        col_c = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2.0
        x_c = (col_c - 255.5) / 256.0 * d
        x_w = 0.0 - d
        y_w = 2.5 + x_c
        print(f'Comp {i}: bot={bot}, d={d:.3f}, x_w={x_w:.3f}, y_w={y_w:.3f}, col=[{xs.min()},{xs.max()}], row=[{ys.min()},{ys.max()}]')
"
